title: Advanced Scalable Systems for Agentic AI
weeklyTopics: Agents as a New System Workload
skills: reading and presenting systems research papers
kv-cache and context management for llms
ai system security and access control
capacity, cost, and reliability analysis for ai infrastructure
power and energy efficiency for ai systems
research project execution and technical writing
workloadNotes: Weekly paper readings/discussion with student paper presentations and written summaries; a semester-long group research project with a mid-semester presentation, final report, and final presentation.
prerequisitesText: Good programming skills and at least one undergraduate systems-related course (operating systems/EECS482, databases/EECS484, distributed systems/EECS491, or networking/EECS489). Undergrad ML/AI course helpful but not required.
